ServiceRevisionSummary.description: The information about the number of requested, pending, and running tasks for a service revision.

Arn.description: The ARN of the service revision.

PendingTaskCount.description: The number of pending tasks for the service revision.

RequestedTaskCount.description: The number of requested tasks for the service revision.

RunningTaskCount.description: The number of running tasks for the service revision.

schema.description: Resource schema for an Amazon ECS service deployment. A service deployment happens when you release a software update for a service by updating the service to use a new service revision. This is a read-only resource that provides visibility into the service deployments of an Amazon ECS service.

Cluster.description: The short name of the cluster that hosts the service (the cluster segment of the service deployment ARN).

ClusterArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the cluster that hosts the service.

CreatedAt.description: The time the service deployment was created.

Service.description: The short name of the service (the service segment of the service deployment ARN).

ServiceArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the service for this service deployment.

ServiceDeploymentArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the service deployment.

ServiceDeploymentId.description: The service deployment identifier (the trailing segment of the service deployment ARN).

Status.description: The status of the service deployment. Valid values include PENDING, SUCCESSFUL, STOPPED, STOP_REQUESTED, IN_PROGRESS, ROLLBACK_REQUESTED, ROLLBACK_IN_PROGRESS, ROLLBACK_SUCCESSFUL, and ROLLBACK_FAILED.

UpdatedAt.description: The time the service deployment was last updated.
